## About
Durabuild Transmission Co. LLC is a family owned and operated shop on W Hatcher Rd in Phoenix. Transmissions are our main work, standard and automatic, on imported and domestic vehicles.
We also handle general auto repair, differentials, clutches and air conditioning. If your car needs repairs, maintenance or just a regular check, give us a call or stop by during the week.
We hold a 4.4 rating on Google from 41 reviews.

## Services
- Transmission service: Transmission work is what we are known for, on imported and domestic vehicles.
- General auto repair: Repairs beyond the transmission, including differentials, clutches and air conditioning.
- Maintenance and regular checks: Bring your car in for routine maintenance or a regular check.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on imported cars as well as domestic?
A: Yes. We work on both imported and domestic vehicles.

Q: Do you work on both standard and automatic cars?
A: Yes. Whether your car is a standard or an automatic, bring it in.
